descriptions.d26c_spawn_group_list_800e5f98: Take a new group id, read the named record, return 0 on failure or when attach is 0. If the record is a list (0x803678d8 type chain) iterate its names. For each entry create the object from one of two factory keys by the record kind and attach mode, init or attach a labelled string, load by name, store the group at +104 and register the virtual owner through 0x80164514. Returns the group id.
